views.do: document.querySelector('#nav-right').click(); (function go(n) { var f = document.querySelector('#fade'); if (document.body.dataset.room === 'hallway' && f && !f.classList.contains('on')) setTimeout(function () { var d = document.querySelector('#svg-host [data-id="bathroom"]'); if (d) d.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); }, 300); else if (n) setTimeout(function () { go(n - 1); }, 150); })(80)
